title: The Memory Walk
summary: Attach each item to a place in a familiar route.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: How can you remember a list of 5 things: milk, eggs, rice, soap, bananas?
points: How can you remember a list of 5 things: milk, eggs, rice, soap, bananas?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The brain remembers places and pictures better than lists.
points: The brain remembers places and pictures better than lists.

steps.title: The method: Place things on a walk
sentences: Put each item at a spot: milk in the doorway, eggs on the sofa, rice on the table, soap in the sink, bananas on the bed.
Make each picture strange and funny.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Walk through the home in your mind to recall the list.
This method is called the method of loci, used since ancient times.
The sillier the picture, the better it sticks.
points: Walk through the home in your mind to recall the list.
